name: vericto-proxy
description: Query PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB with every statement checked first and run read-only in a transaction that rolls back

setup.notice: Docker is required and the database must be reachable from the container. Give the agent its own read-only database role: the credential stays with the server, and every statement is checked before it runs read-only in a transaction that always rolls back.
steps: Create a read-only database role for the agent and note its connection URL.
Connect the plugin and paste that URL when asked for VERICTO_MCP_DATABASE_URL.
Ask the session to call whoami to confirm the database, the limits and that the role cannot write.
